open_questions_for_vendor: Please confirm the full legal name and legal form of the Orb entity that contracts with Tavus, Inc. (as it appears in the DPA signature block), and its registered address. This must match the entity Tavus named in TOM questionnaire #8.3.
Have you designated a representative in the EU under Article 27 GDPR? If yes, please provide the representative's name and full address; if no, please confirm in writing that none is designated.

Have you formally appointed a Data Protection Officer? If yes, please provide the DPO's name, telephone number and/or email address. If no, please provide the telephone number and/or email address of a contact entitled to respond to data-protection-related requests from SAP.

Which third-party audit certifications do you currently hold (SOC 1, SOC 2 Type I/II, SOC 3, ISO 27001, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO 9001, ISO 22301)? Please provide the current SOC 2 Type II report and/or certificates so they can be attached as audit evidence and filed in Vanta.
What encryption standard do you enforce for data in transit between Tavus and Orb (exact minimum TLS version)?
What encryption standard do you use for customer data at rest (e.g. AES-256), and are backups of customer data encrypted with the same standard?
Who generates and manages the encryption keys protecting Tavus's data at rest — Orb (shared or customer-specific keys), or does Orb support customer-managed keys?

Can Orb, acting as a processor, anonymize and/or pseudonymize personal data processed on Tavus's behalf (e.g. billing contact identifiers, usage event attributes) on Tavus's instruction — as distinct from de-identifying data for Orb's own analytics purposes?
Please list your other technical safeguards relevant to the SAP DPP TOM (network isolation, access controls, MFA/SSO for admin access, logging/monitoring, vulnerability management, etc.).
Where is customer data hosted (cloud provider and regions), and do you offer an EU hosting region / EU data residency option for the data Orb processes for Tavus?

Please provide your current sub-processor list for the service (SAP requires the processing chain to Level 2, e.g. the cloud provider hosting Orb and any analytics/AI vendors touching Tavus usage or billing data).
